purpose: Continue raw coverage through 53239, 25933, 92335, 39425, 43529, 54923, 22345 and 32542 while retaining Linux/kernel security, agent security, secured ship networking, aviation qualification, regulated cell-therapy manufacturing, PCB materials, structural steel, logistics equipment and defense opportunity intelligence independently of Glob evidence.

policy.rule: Raw CVE, legacy vulnerability, ISO/QPL/MIL specification, manufacturer-authorization, article-number, reseller-product-code and postal-code occurrences are retained with zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: High operational or engineering utility does not convert an identifier into P1/P2; physical promotion requires independently verified unit-bearing physical semantics and provenance.
policy.source_quality: Primary/official authorities are used for substantive source utility wherever available; derivative identifiers remain raw controls unless independently reconciled to the primary source.

information_updates.finding: ISO/WD 25933 supplies a current maritime cyber-physical test architecture covering IPv6 Ethernet, application/service announcement, smart-ship datagrams, IPv4 interoperability, transitions between secured/open modes and ESP/TLS/DTLS-based authentication, integrity and confidentiality.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 25933 is the working-draft identifier and contributes zero physical Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: The Linux 53239 CVE pair provides two reusable kernel-hardening concurrency/resource-lifetime cases: a locking/UAF race in XFRM policy handling and a missing allocation-return check in DRM display code.

PraisonAI CVE-2026-39891 is directly relevant to bounded agent tooling: unescaped agent input reached template-rendering file tools and could execute template expressions as code. Worldshepherd should treat agent-to-template/tool serialization as an explicit trust boundary.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 92335 is only a legacy vulnerability-database ID; the authoritative vulnerability identifier is CVE-2026-39891.

information_updates.finding: MHRA 54923 provides a current regulated-manufacturing due-diligence template for live-cell/cell-therapy products with explicit authorisation, aseptic-manufacturing, batch-certification, packaging and microbiological/biological QC scope.

The fail-safe-steel paper demonstrates scale-relevant materials validation: a 1.4-ton low-alloy steel component used deformation-assisted tempering to improve strength/fracture-toughness balance via subgrain structure and dispersed nanocarbides.
The Eglin 32542 opportunity cluster is useful for capture intelligence but must be date-filtered: some notices are historical/inactive. Postal-code recurrence is not an opportunity match by itself.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 32542 is the place-of-performance ZIP code in those notices, separately from MIL-PRF-32542.

Check Worldshepherd Python/agent dependencies and tool/template rendering paths for PraisonAI or analogous unsafe template-evaluation patterns before creating a remediation item.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical P1/P2 candidates, maintaining fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls.
